subject: FinTrust: clarification on UK data flows, SOC 2 Type II coverage, and evidence package
body:
--- Message 1/6 (2026-11-20 09:12 GMT) ---
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintrust.co.uk>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Malik <sara.malik@fintrust.co.uk>, security-audit@fintrust.co.uk
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 & UK data flow evidence request

Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and our security team ran a quick gap analysis and we have a couple of follow-ups before we move to legal review:

- We need a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report and the exact audit period covered.
- Confirmation of where customer production data is hosted for our UK tenants (region / physical locations).
- If the SOC 2 report does not fully cover UK-hosted processing for the same audit period, would you provide a bridge letter explaining coverage and any planned remediations/timelines?
- A short evidence checklist (PDF or spreadsheet) that maps requested items (SCCs, DPA clauses, logging/audit evidence) to the documents you can provide.

Our target for completing security review is EoD next Tuesday (30 Nov). Can you confirm whether that's feasible and what you can share today?

Best,
Liam
Security & Compliance, FinTrust

--- Message 2/6 (2026-11-23 10:45 GMT) ---
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintrust.co.uk>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & UK data flow evidence request

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent cover: 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31). Full report attached where permitted; we will redact internal-only sections if required.
- Confirmation: Production customer data for UK-tagged tenants is stored in our UK/AMS cloud region (hosts in London data centers operated by our cloud provider). See attached data-flow diagram.
- If you need a formal bridge letter, we can supply one that explains the audit scope, any control gaps for UK-specific hosting, and the timeline for the next audit cycle.
- I've attached a draft evidence checklist mapping your items to documents we can share (controls, logs, SCC excerpt, DPA clause text).

Can your team accept the SOC 2 PDF with redactions? If not, we can arrange an in-person/executive summary and a controlled evidence review session.

I'll ask Priyom to prep the evidence package and Kimberly to confirm contract language.

Regards,
Markus
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

(attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025-11-01_to_2026-10-31.pdf)
(attachment: redwood-uk-data-flow-diagram.png)
(attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist-FT-20261123.xlsx)

--- Message 3/6 (2026-11-24 14:22 GMT) ---
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintrust.co.uk>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & UK data flow evidence request

Liam — looping in the artifacts. Quick notes:

- Attached: SOC 2 report PDF (redacted to remove vendor-specific ops notes) and a PNG of the UK data flow. See file names above.
- Evidence checklist now includes hyperlinks to the specific log retention policy and KMS key access matrix. Where logs are considered sensitive, we can provide scoped extracts and time-limited access.
- Regarding bridge letters: we can issue a short letter confirming that the audit period above covers controls for our primary US/AMS regions; for UK-specific physical hosting the controls were exercised but the auditor's report tags the control locations under the cloud provider's environment. The bridge letter will explicitly state which controls were tested versus which rely on the cloud provider's SOC scope.

Next steps from our side: I will package the evidence ZIP and upload to a one-time Share link for your audit team by EOD 27 Nov.

— Priyom

(attachment: DPA_ScheduleA_SCC_excerpt.pdf)

--- Message 4/6 (2026-11-26 09:06 GMT) ---
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintrust.co.uk>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & UK data flow evidence request

Hi Liam —

Quick note on contractual items:

- DPA: Schedule A excerpt attached. It includes our standard SCCs and the customer data processing terms. If FinTrust needs minor wording changes (e.g., data residency guarantees), we can propose a short addendum; please flag exact clauses and we can route to Legal.
- Audit access: if your auditors need deeper evidence (raw logs, KMS audit trails), we prefer a controlled review session with our security team rather than raw extracts. This keeps sensitive metadata protected while still providing proof-of-control.

Happy to set a 30-minute review with our security lead. Suggest Fri 28 Nov 10:00 UK time. Does that work?

Thanks,
Kimberly

--- Message 5/6 (2026-11-27 11:18 GMT) ---
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintrust.co.uk>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, security-audit@fintrust.co.uk
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & UK data flow evidence request

Thanks team — received the documents.

A couple clarifications before Legal takes the DPA to redlines:

1) Does the SOC 2 report explicitly include controls over encryption key management for customer data? If so, which KMS (cloud-provider or customer-managed) was in scope?
2) For the bridge letter: please list the precise controls not covered for UK physical hosting (if any) versus the ones with auditor evidence.
3) Confirm whether any telemetry necessary for FinTrust audit (request IDs, correlation IDs) will be available in the exported extracts or only in scoped screenshots during the review session.

We can do the 28 Nov review at 10:00 UK time — I've tentatively booked it.

Best,
Liam

--- Message 6/6 (2026-11-30 16:45 GMT) ---
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintrust.co.uk>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & UK data flow evidence request — final package

Liam —

Appreciate the patience. Following our review session (thanks to your auditors for the focused questions), we've uploaded the final package to the secure share and attached the items below. Summary answers inline:

- SOC 2 & key management: The audit includes controls mapped to encryption and KMS procedures. The auditor tested our use of the cloud-provider KMS (customer-managed keys not in scope for the last audit). We documented KMS key rotation and access controls in the evidence bundle (see 'KMS-access-matrix.pdf' in the share).
- Bridge letter: Attached is a brief bridge letter that enumerates which controls were fully tested (logical access, change management, incident response) and which controls are covered under the cloud provider SOC (physical security, some hypervisor-level controls). We commit to including UK-hosting-specific controls in the next audit cycle; the letter includes the planned timeline.
- Telemetry: Correlation IDs and request identifiers are available as scoped extracts. For privacy and security we provide redacted extracts and a time-limited auditor view; full raw streams are not exported.

Attachments uploaded and attached to this message where allowed:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025-11-01_to_2026-10-31.pdf
- redwood-uk-data-flow-diagram.png
- DPA_ScheduleA_SCC_excerpt.pdf
- redwood-evidence-checklist-FT-20261130.xlsx
- KMS-access-matrix.pdf
- bridge-letter-Redwood-UK-hosting-20261130.pdf

If Legal needs a draft DPA addendum, send the specific clause text and we'll respond within 48 hours. Otherwise, are we good to move to contract signature? Let me know and we can route to Sales Ops.

Regards,
Markus
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

(attachments: listed above)

-- End of thread --
